Education Domain - Financial Aid Regulations

Financial aid is governed by FERPA, higher education acts, and financial regulations.

For Student Loan Application: Required attributes include student identifier, student name, date of birth, enrollment verification, academic standing, loan amount requested, purpose, financial information (income, assets) for need-based loans, co-signer information if required, and bank account for disbursement. Credit check may be required. KYC documents per banking regulations.

For Fee Waiver Request: Required attributes include student identifier, fee waiver type, justification documentation (financial hardship proof, special circumstances), family income information (for means-tested waivers), supporting documents, and approval decision. Financial documentation required for need-based waivers.

For Education Grant: Required attributes include applicant identifier, grant type, eligibility criteria verification, application date, academic performance (for merit-based grants), financial information (for need-based grants), and bank account for disbursement. Research proposal if applicable. Institutional endorsement if required.

For Scholarship Verification: Required attributes include student identifier, scholarship name/number, award date, award amount, disbursement method, verification status, and institution information. Academic standing may be required for renewal verification.

For Financial Assistance Program: Required attributes include applicant identifier, program type, eligibility criteria verification, application date, financial documentation (income, assets, expenses), family composition, and bank account for disbursement. Supporting documentation as per program requirements.

UNNECESSARY Attributes: Religion is unnecessary unless for religious institution scholarships with legal basis. Political affiliation is never required. Detailed medical history is unnecessary unless disability-related accommodations affect financial need.

FERPA: Financial aid records are part of education records protected by FERPA. Disclosure requires student consent (if 18+) or parent consent (if minor).

Banking Regulations: Student loans must comply with banking KYC and lending regulations. Financial information must be protected per financial privacy laws.

Data Minimization: Collect only financial information necessary for determining eligibility and disbursement. Do not collect excessive financial details.
